body.heading: Where in the world is Kiribati?
paragraphs: Kiribati is a country in Micronesia, which is part of Oceania. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Kiribati is South Tarawa.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Kiribati speak Gilbertese and English. Gilbertese, also called te taetae ni Kiribati, is the language of everyday life across the islands.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Kiribati is the Australian dollar.

body.heading: How big is Kiribati?
paragraphs: Kiribati covers about 811 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Palau.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Kiritimati is the world's largest coral atoll, famous for bonefishing flats, bird sanctuaries and being among the first places on Earth to greet the New Year.
On Betio, rusting tanks and guns from the famous 1943 battle stand in the lagoon shallows — powerful history beside island villages and beaches.
